long_biography.plain_text:
Shakhtar Donetsk gave Rinat Akhmetov a second institution to build beyond SCM. A childhood supporter, he became owner and president in 1996 when the club lacked its own stadium and training base. Investment in an academy, facilities and international recruitment helped Shakhtar break Dynamo Kyiv's domestic dominance and win the UEFA Cup.

His charitable foundation created a separate platform for sustained social work. It has supported cancer diagnosis and treatment, child welfare, national adoption reform and emergency assistance for civilians across Ukraine. The organisation combines durable health and family initiatives with rapid humanitarian response.
